serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Ecclesiasticalot FF: He’s a very crude man. If he wasn’t my saviour I would have zapped him too. He said some really nasty things about me. I zapped people for less.
You: Stop zapping people! You ended in the trash can, because you went on a wild chase after some thugs in the first place!
#Priestbot.Face.botFaceSad
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Well, maybe that's something to reflect upon…
#Priestbot.Face.botFacePeaceful
Ecclesiasticalot FF: …Although at a later time. I worry about Shanice since I left her alone and I’m not good at multitasking so I can’t worry and reflect upon something at the same time.
#Priestbot.Face.botFaceNeutral
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Once again, thank you for your help, Anon, and goodnight.
You: Goodnight…
